justification: Both surfaces carry highly schematic imagery including simplified human forms and curved lines, and A includes a prominent concentric disc while B has no such motif in comparable role; the only real overlap is the generic idea of stylised anthropomorphic forms reduced to simple shapes. A is a large sculpted head-and-torso figure with low-relief symbols (rings, arcs, banded elements) distributed over its curved back, whereas B is a flat two-figure-in-a-boat silhouette scene with an explicit vessel line and upturned prows, a specific composition entirely absent from A.
